notes.title: Update V0.1.1 - Better Physics & More!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]My new machine arrived a whole week early, so I wasted no time setting it up and building out [b]version 0.1.1[/b].[/p][p]This update brings improvements to the [b]settings menu[/b], giving you more control over physics and time-of-day options:[/p][p][/p][h3]Breast Physics Settings[/h3][p]You can now tweak three key parameters:[/p][list][*][p][b]Dampening[/b]: controls how motion slows down[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elasticity[/b]: adjusts the bounce and rebound[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stiffness[/b]: fine-tunes overall firmness[/p][/*][/list][p]On top of that, there’s a new [b]Surface Physics[/b] toggle. Turn it on to add skin rippling effects when under pressure.[/p][p][/p][h3]Time of Day Options[/h3][p]Choose how the world looks and feels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Real-Time[/b] – syncs with your system clock[/p][/*][*][p][b]Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Night[/b] – pick a static time of day[/p][/*][*][p][b]Debug[/b] – cycles day/night super fast (originally built for testing lighting, but it’s surprisingly fun to watch!)[/p][/*][/list][p]That’s it for this round, but I’ve got more in the pipeline. Keep an eye on the news section for the next big update![/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update 1 – What’s Coming Soon! (still working hard on it)
notes.notes:
[p]BOOBS has been released and the reviews are dripping in. (If you haven't reviewed the game, please do! <3)

Some reviews mentioned a handful of issues. If you run into issues please don't write a negative review but post it in the discussion boards. 
[/p][p]I’m currently working on a new update to improve your experience with BOOBS. Here’s what you can expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]Resolution Settings:[/b] You’ll be able to adjust the game’s resolution directly. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Settings:[/b] You'll be able to control the volume to your liking with new sound options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Fixes:[/b] Controller support on Steam Deck is being addressed to make gameplay smoother. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Improvements:[/b] Optimizations to help the game run better on Steam Deck devices (and all other devices but on Steam Deck it's very noticeable).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slap Tracking:[/b] The game will store and load your total number of slaps, plus show how many slaps you’ve done in your current session (which is relevant for the achievements).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Fixes:[/b] Fixing an issue where hair was rendering behind clothes for a more polished look.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your patience and support — can’t wait to get this update out to you! If you run into any more issues, please post it in the discussion boards. I'm monitoring them <3. [/p]
